coordinate_convention: STEP X = footprint local X; STEP Y = minus footprint local Y; STEP Z = height above component-side PCB surface. Footprint placement rotation is applied by KiCad; do not separately duplicate it in model rotation.

models.source: ../esp_footprint_review.md: Espressif datasheet Fig. 10-1 and Fig. 11-1; nominal 15.4 x 20.5 x 2.4 mm and 5.05 mm antenna region
approximations: Green rectangular substrate is illustratively 0.8 mm thick; this thickness is not a sourced controlled dimension.
Silver solid rectangular shield covers the non-antenna region to the nominal 2.4 mm overall height; exact shield inset, stamping, seam and corner radii are not represented.
No antenna copper pattern, electrical pins, internal components or functional geometry is invented. Antenna region is visibly exposed substrate.

models.source: ../HC-FPC-05-09-40RLTAG.geometry.json and ../HC-FPC-05-09-NRLTAG_vendor_page1.png: manufacturer Rev A drawing, 40-contact row
approximations: Closed state only: 22.0 x 3.5 x 1.0 mm nominal envelope; 3.5 mm depth is a reference dimension, height tolerance is +/-0.1 mm. Open actuator reference height 1.55 mm is not modeled.
Natural LCP housing is a simplified rectangular shell with a visibly open front slot, black rear-flip actuator is simplified without hinge mechanism.

Entry width uses drawing C=20.57 mm; entry depth uses cross-section 1.30 mm; floor uses cross-section 0.19 mm. Slot height 0.35 mm is illustrative clearance for the specified 0.30 mm cable, not a controlled vendor opening-height claim.
Actuator width 21.10 mm and rectangular cover subdivision are visual approximations, not a functional articulation model.
Contacts, retention tabs, mold reliefs, hinges and cable are intentionally omitted; no functional contact geometry is invented.
